author: Yffe
content: Part (ii-a): land the LEAN SPINE PREREQUISITES per proof-backends.md §4/§6.1 in a NEW lean/Thermite/Stabilize.lean (importing the spine). Define stabilizes/stabilizesProp matching Denote.lean's intVal/denote; prove stabilizes_unique (overlap-at-max, the #214 lever); a Bool specCallFree over the full mutual AST (Expr/Pred/MatchArm/RangeArg); the FUEL-IRRELEVANCE lemma intVal_fuel_irrelevant/denote_fuel_irrelevant by mutual well-founded recursion (env generalized) with the fuel-free tier-(a) corollaries; and stabilization_exists honestly in the RegistryTerminating HYPOTHESIS form (the general core-Lean form is unprovable for an arbitrary registry; the hypothesis is the REQ-1.2 REGISTRY-TERMINATION obligation). No sorry. Import into Thermite.lean; mark the spine-prerequisite rows SHIPPED in the design doc. Do not touch the spine modules or the 4 pins; confirm pins still build. Gauntlet: lake build (full+pins), #print axioms standard-set-only, cargo build --workspace.
